text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: My deam is――that "rainbow".

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Further beyond the strongest.
To reach the end of 
that rainbow.
And what's at the end of that rainbow――

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
――France. The place my parents met. 
And the country my dad is currently active
in.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
That's the place I want to reach the top
at. 
Right, just like my dad.

text_block_list.name: Young Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Dad. Why are you trying to make the top
brand? 
If you didn't have work,
then we could spend more time together.

text_block_list.name: Laurel's Father
text_block_list.text:
Laurel. Well, that's……because only those 
at the top can shine the brightest.

text_block_list.name: Laurel's Father
text_block_list.text:
To make everyone the happiest, proudest,
and bring 
the most joy,
you can't be anything but the best.

text_block_list.name: Laurel's Father
text_block_list.text:
There are many people in the world.
What the one at the top is 
able to accomplish can determine just how
happy everyone can become.

text_block_list.name: Laurel's Father
text_block_list.text:
That's why I can't stop.
I want to improve my designs and 
operate in more countries and build the
greatest brand.

text_block_list.name: Laurel's Father
text_block_list.text:
Just like our brand's icon, the rainbow. 
Huge, and filled with colors.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
I am--an Uma Musume. And for Uma Musume, 
the pinnacle of Uma Musume.
There's the greatest race.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
And I want to win there. No,
I don't want to just win, 
I want to win in the greatest way
possible.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
That's my dream.
And everyone's happiness. 
The place my dad is aiming for,
and that I am too――the sky.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
One that everyone knows about and aspires
to. 
Held west of Paris along the Seine river.
A race 
course said to be the most beautiful in the
world……

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
And in the entire history of Tracen
Academy, 
nobody has won.
What could truly be called the 
greatest international G1. Its name is――

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: The Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe.

『Legs of Glass』…… 
The impression of her being weak
disappeared.

This Uma Musume, Sakura Laurel, 
had no intention of settling for a lesser
dream……

She was aiming to 『Fulfill』 the biggest dream.
With a strong desire 
to show 『I can fulfill it』.
Straight-forwardly chasing after it.

……Seeing that desire drew me to her. 
And before I realized it――I said aloud.
choice_data_list: I want to see that dream……together

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: ……? Trainer-san?
choice_data_list: I want to fulfill that dream together!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Ah……Thank you very much! But……

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
If you really feel that way,
it'll be a while…… 
would you be willing to wait several seasons
for that?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Yes. My dream won't change. 
But, as you've already seen……

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
How was it Brian?
The match ended up as a victory for me
but, 
was there any other Uma Musume who caught
your eye?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ……No. There was noone like that.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: I can't really run! Well――

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: There isn't anyone like that. Well――

text_block_list.name: Laurel & Brian
text_block_list.text:
――At least, not yet! 
――At least, not yet.

Spring hadn't arrived yet. 
It would be a while,
but eventually Spring would arrive.
And time passed――

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Have you heard, Bakushin O-san? 
Laurel-san turned down another offer from
a famous trainer.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Oooh, is that so……!? But,
I'm pretty sure her 
condition has improved quite a lot since
then.

The second time I met that Uma Musume
was―― 
Under rows of cherry blossoms in full
bloom.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
……Hello, Trainer-san. 
We're always under your care.
choice_data_list: Do you have a trainer yet?
Do you have a trainer yet?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
No, not yet. 
I was thinking of recruiting one right about
now.
In that case――
choice_data_list: Will you form a contract with me?
Will you form a contract with me?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Contract……?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: ……Muuu, I refuse.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Calling it a contract……don't you think that's
kind of distant? 
Isn't there a more fitting thing for us?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Just think back. 
On that day, the words we exchanged.

……That's right. 
Those words from that day, once more…….
choice_data_list: I want to fulfill that dream together!
I want to fulfill that dream together!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
……Yes. I'm looking forward to it! 
I'm sorry for making you wait,
Trainer-san♪

That day,
under the cherry blossoms in full bloom, 
Sakura Laurel and I didn't make a
"contract"……

We vowed to make that dream come true,
together.
